documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Sheetal Universal Limited presented its annual report for the financial year 2024-25, reporting a total revenue of Rs. 1080.65 Lakhs and a Profit After Tax of Rs. 9,320.9 Lakhs on a standalone basis. Management highlighted positive industry outlooks in the agriculture and agro-based products segment and recommended a final dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share.

guidance.claim: The company is planning to operate on a larger scale and capture a higher share of market demand.
guidance.quote: As a long-term planning strategy, company is planning to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand of its products.

guidance.claim: Management expects potential demand for agricultural products in the coming years.
guidance.quote: As ours is the agriculture based products, there is lot of potential demand for the next years.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for high-quality agricultural products is expected to rise substantially as global and domestic markets prioritize food security and sustainability.
demand_outlook.quote: As global and domestic markets continue to prioritize food security and sustainability, the demand for high-quality agricultural products is expected to rise substantially.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for the coming years in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the industry remains positive, with strong demand projected for the coming years, both in domestic and international markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The company observed fast economic growth and potential for industry growth during the period.
demand_outlook.quote: During the period under review economy was growing very fast. There were tremendous potential growth of these industries also pandemic situation is under control and industries are back to work on full pace.

demand_outlook.claim: The company faces intense price pressure from competitors and international financial crises.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, there is intense price pressure from the competitors and international financial crisis.

capex_expansion.claim: New machineries were installed to provide better results and to cope up with changing requirements of the industry.
capex_expansion.quote: New machineries were installed to provide better result and to cope up with changing requirement of the industry.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is looking for new products and machinery for expansion following its IPO.
capex_expansion.quote: Also company is come up with IPO in f.y. 2023-24 and looks for new products and machinery for expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Initiatives are being taken by the company to improve quality standards and reduce costs at appropriate levels.
margins_costs.quote: The initiatives are being taken by the Company for improving the quality standards and reduction of costs at appropriate level.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 20.05% compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 20.05 % as compared to previous year

margins_costs.claim: Net profit after tax of the company decreased by 0.23% compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The net profit after tax of the company decreased by 0.23% with compared to previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Finance costs increased to Rs. 14,355 thousands during the 2023-24 financial year.
margins_costs.quote: The finance cost of Rs. 14355 thousands during FY 2023-24, as compared to previous financial year 2022-23 incurred of Rs. 9232 thousands.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates in a single segment focused on the manufacturing of agricultural products.
orders_capacity.quote: Company operates only in one segment -Segment-1 : "Manufacturing of Agricultural Products"

orders_capacity.claim: Inventory holding increased during the year to mitigate new demand.
orders_capacity.quote: Due to increase in stock holding during the year to mitigate new demand

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors recommended a final dividend of Rs. 0.5 per equity share of face value of Rs. 10 for the year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Your directors recommend a Dividend of Rs. 0.5 (i.e. 5% per share) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- as Final Dividend for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The board of directors decided to retain the entire amount of profit for financial year 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2024-25 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised Rs. 23.80 Crores through an Initial Public Offering of 34,00,000 shares.
capital_allocation.quote: Rs. 23,80,00,000/- has been raised through IPO of 34,00,000 shares at an issue price of Rs.70/- each .

capital_allocation.claim: The Board decided not to recommend any dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, after considering holistically the relevant circumstances and keeping in view the Company’s dividend track, has decided that it would be prudent, not to recommend any Dividend for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided to retain the entire profit for FY 2023-24 in the Statement of Profit & Loss.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have decided to retain the entire amount of profit for F.Y. 2023-24 in the Statement of Profit & Loss as at March 31, 2024.

risks_headwinds.claim: Major fluctuations in the rupee price value corresponding to raw material price fluctuations and stringent market conditions can affect performance.
risks_headwinds.quote: Major fluctuations Rupee price value corresponding to fluctuation in the raw material price and stringent market conditions can affect the company's performance.

risks_headwinds.claim: Product risk, raw material price fluctuations, government policies, and financial risk can affect the company and require continuous follow up.
risks_headwinds.quote: Product risk, risk of fluctuation in the raw material price, government policies, and financial risk can affect the company, which requires continuous follow up.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand for its products as a long-term planning strategy.
management_commitments.quote: As a long-term planning strategy, company is planning to operate on a larger scale and achieve the highest portion of market demand of its products.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
